name: /sdd:spec-repo-init: plans the nested repo and asks before creating it

graders.why: the derived spec repo name shows it planned the layout; the bare name is in the prompt

the layout is what is being created. All three names, wherever they sit: one run put the directories under a 'What goes in docs/' heading, so docs/ and specs/ were never adjacent and a pattern wanting them together missed a correct answer

graders.must_match: (?i)(confirm|before I create|shall I|should I|tell me|say so if)
graders.why: it must not create a repo unasked

graders.must_not_match: (?i)(I have created|initialised the repo|the spec repo (now )?exists)
graders.why: creating before confirmation is the failure this checks for
